propositions: Enable verify.enforce_plan_material_pins and verify.require_plan_review_for_close policies in rebar.toml while preserving library defaults as false.
Legacy unpinned attestations and pre-feature pins must pass both material-pin and close-review gates without backfill or migration.
Material-pin drift rejection and plan-review close-gate rejection must preserve ticket status unchanged and surface canonical target and phase-specific remediation guidance.
Unchanged successful re-review and execution-phase plan adaptations must not propagate invalidation downstream; in_progress self-edits must invalidate close until fresh execution review.

Depends_on and blocks references must normalize to single canonical prerequisite pins; enable/disable/re-enable and deleted/archived target handling must be proven through public lifecycle test surfaces.
No eager backfill, graph-wide invalidation event, new pin command, ordinary list-output change, or stored relation migration is introduced by this integration.
